description:
Turn a task description into ranked candidate files and a ready-to-run project_read_batch call (keyword search plus recent files; deterministic, returns no file contents).
Use when: you start in an unfamiliar area: run steps[0] instead of guessing files.
Avoid when: you know the files (project_read_batch) or only need one string or name (project_search).
Output: keywords[], candidates[] {relative_path, reason, hits}, steps[] {tool, arguments, why}.

files_hint.description: Files you already suspect (ranked first, no search needed for them).

include_search.description: 1 runs keyword searches (default); 0 plans only from files_hint/recent files.

max_files.description: Max candidates to plan (default 6; batch accepts 8).

task_description.description: What you are about to do, in one line, e.g. "add retry handling to the GitHub client".
